# The Roof Technician

> Professional roofing services specializing in commercial and residential roof repair, restoration, and skylight installation across Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area.

The Roof Technician is a roofing contractor serving the Toronto GTA region with expertise in both commercial and residential projects. The company focuses on leak repair, waterproofing, roof restoration, and skylight installation with WSIB certification.

## Key Topics

- Commercial roofing
- Residential roof repair
- Skylight installation
- Leak repair
- Waterproofing
- Flat roof systems
- Roof restoration
- Water infiltration
- Ice damming
- Toronto GTA
- Shingle repair
- Energy efficiency
- Commercial properties
- WSIB certified

## Commercial Roofing Services

- [Commercial Roof](https://therooftechnician.ca/project/commercial-roof): Commercial roof repair and replacement services in Toronto
- [Commercial Flat Roof](https://therooftechnician.ca/project/commercial-flat-roof): Commercial flat roof installation and membrane replacement in Toronto
- [Commercial Skylights](https://therooftechnician.ca/project/commercial-skylights): Commercial skylight installation and waterproofing services in Toronto GTA
- [Skylights Commercial Roof](https://therooftechnician.ca/project/skylights-commercial-roof): Commercial roof skylight repair and restoration in Greater Toronto Area

## Residential Roofing Services

- [Residential Skylights](https://therooftechnician.ca/project/residential-skylights): Residential skylight installation and waterproofing in Toronto GTA
- [Skylights Roof](https://therooftechnician.ca/project/skylights-roof): Residential skylight leak repair and roof restoration in Toronto
